subject: Re: Conversion playbook — POC credits, schedule & conversion terms
messages:
From: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.riley@acmehealth.com, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-23T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC follow-up and next steps

Sergio — thanks again for the demo last week. Tom and I reviewed internally and we want to formalize a short MAP so legal/procurement can move quickly. Two asks up front: 1) Can you extend the POC credits by two weeks? Our engineering lead lost a week on hiring and we need extra time to hit the quality milestone. 2) We need a conversion price range so procurement can budget (ballpark is fine).

Also attaching the internal timeline we use for vendor evaluations. Happy to take a short call to sync.

— Emma
Director of Product, ACME Health
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-24T08:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC follow-up and next steps

Emma — appreciate the quick read. Short answers here and a proposed path: 1) Extension: we can add two weeks to the evaluation window (no-cost credits) provided we align on the MAP milestones so we keep to a firm conversion decision by the end date. 2) Conversion pricing: we can give a committed convert offer scoped to your expected throughput. Ballpark: $25k/month for the first 6 months on a 6-month commit (~30% off list pricing) if you convert within 30 days of the MAP completion.

Proposed MAP (high level):
- Week 0: Onboarding + connectivity (Redwood private keys, dataset redaction checklist)
- Week 1–2: Latency & throughput baseline (Redwood runs benchmarks)
- Week 3–4: Quality evaluation vs. your acceptance prompts (ACME to provide final prompt set) — signoff required to trigger conversion clock
- Week 5–6 (extension weeks): Integration testing + production-facing spike

We will attach a formal MAP doc and SOW with credit amounts (we usually provide $18k in inference credits for a 6-week POC; we can increase to $25k to cover the two-week extension). If this looks ok I can loop in pricing ops to finalize the spreadsheet.

Would 11am PT Wednesday for a 30-minute sync work?

— Sergio
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Riley <tom.riley@acmehealth.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-25T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC follow-up and next steps

Sergio / Emma — 11am PT Wednesday works for me. Quick procurement note: we need to see the exact credit reconciliation method and audit trail (how credits map to token usage, and what happens to unused credits on conversion). Also, can you confirm if the conversion discount is front-loaded (applies to first invoice only) or applied across the committed term?

Thanks,
Tom
Senior IT Procurement, ACME Health
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Tom Riley <tom.riley@acmehealth.com>, Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-26T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC follow-up and next steps — credits & audit

Tom — quick answers from ops:
- Credit reconciliation: we provide a CSV export and a token-level audit (timestamped) for the POC. On conversion any remaining credits can either be credited toward the first invoice or refunded (refunds require procurement sign-off; credits toward invoice is the default).
- Discount application: discount is applied pro-rata across the committed term invoices (not just the first invoice) when a conversion is executed under the agreed commit.

I'll upload the sample reconciliation file to the Drive link before the call.

— Marissa
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@acmehealth.com>, Tom Riley <tom.riley@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-27T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: POC follow-up and next steps — proposed SOW and commitments

Attaching updated MAP + SOW (ACME_MAP_v1.3.pdf and POC_SOW_v2.pdf). Key commercial callouts:
- POC credits: Redwood will provide $25,000 of inference credits, valid for the POC window, covering up to 1.5M tokens of open-model execution.
- Extension: Two-week extension approved; adds 14 calendar days to the MAP end date.
- Conversion options:
   • Option A: 6-month committed term at $20k/month (equivalent to ~30% effective discount vs. on-demand); requires signed commitment within 30 days of MAP signoff.
   • Option B: 12-month committed term at $16k/month with a 45% discount and a 90-day ramp (first two months at 50% committed throughput).
- Ramp & exit: We propose a 90-day ramp on committed throughput to allow traffic shaping and KV cache warm-up. Early termination outside of the ramp window will be subject to buyout clauses spelled out in the SOW.

Please review before the Wed sync — the goal is to lock the conversion window and the preferred option so procurement can route legal.

— Sergio
From: Emma Jenkins <emma.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Riley <tom.riley@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-30T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: POC follow-up and next steps — agreed path

Sergio / team — thanks for the updated docs and clarity. Quick confirm: ACME is aligned with Option B (12-month commit at $16k/month) provided the following are in the SOW: 1) Clear milestone-based signoff at Week 4 for conversion eligibility, 2) Written audit of credit reconciliation within 48 hours of signoff, and 3) a one-time migration credit of $5k applied to the first invoice to cover initial integration costs.

If Redwood can accept those three items we'll route to legal and aim to have a signed MSLA within two weeks of signoff. Can we also confirm that the $25k credits can be applied to the first invoice if ACME converts?

Let's confirm on Thursday and I'll ask procurement to open the PO placeholder.

— Emma
